appliedUpdates.description: Documented that discovery.rs value_template fields must match status_to_json() output — both must be updated together when adding HA entities. Also documented parse_ota_url extraction pattern from ESP32-only code to workspace crate.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: when adding ToggleItem variants, workers should also update docs/protocol.md toggle table and ensure status_to_json() emits the corresponding state fields for HA discovery feedback.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features add-missing-toggle-codes added 9 ToggleItem variants but protocol.md toggle table and status_to_json() were not updated. HA state for aux1/aux2/soak_mode/normal_operation/clear_notification will show null.
